definitions.explanation: An exaggerated or uncontrollable emotional outburst, typically involving screaming, crying, or irrational behavior. In everyday Japanese, used to describe someone who is emotionally volatile or prone to fits of anger.

examples.japanese: ヒステリー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ヒステリー⟦{気味|ぎみ}→気味：27635_gimi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{叫|さけ}んだ→叫ぶ：02108_sakebu⟧。
⟦{些細|ささい}→些細：07160_sasai⟧なこと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ヒステリー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こされる→起こす：01234_okosu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{困|こま}って→困る：00861_komaru⟧しまう。
examples.english: When someone has a hysterical outburst over trivial things, it troubles those around them.

notes:
USAGE:
The most common collocation is ヒステリー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧ (to have a hysterical fit). Can be used as a modifier with ⟦{気味|ぎみ}→気味：27635_gimi⟧ (ヒステリー⟦{気味|ぎみ}→気味：27635_gimi⟧ = somewhat hysterical) or ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (ヒステリック = hysterical, as an adjective).
From German "Hysterie." The related adjective form ヒステリック (from English "hysteric") is also common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ヒステリー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧: to have a hysterical fit
- ヒステリー⟦{気味|ぎみ}→気味：27635_gimi⟧: somewhat hysterical
- ヒステリック(な): hysterical (adjectival form)
